instagram_caption:
Jesus, it has been one year. Why does it still hurt?

Everyone else moved on around month three. She is still flinching at the date on the calendar.

She asked if grief has an expiry. "Every morning I bring you something new. Not a replacement. Enough mercy for that day."

Lamentations 3:22-23 was written by someone in the middle of loss, not after it. His compassions never fail, they are new every morning.

Not new as in replacing what you lost. New as in enough for today.
